visual_review_findings: Compared the original (round face, soft tilted beret, big rectangular glasses, small smile, ears) with the rejected drawing (a box with a hat band and two lens boxes on a bar, reading as a radio) at 48px in both themes. Redrew as one head loop: right-leaning beret crown, lenses forming the head sides, elliptical jaw, bridge and smile. Native review: reads as a bespectacled face in a beret; all gaps 8+.
